ExpectedResult: E: has BitLocker enabled; C: is not encrypted/modified for B5.
AwardGuidance: Do not award if only C: was encrypted.

Category: G. BitLocker protected data volume
Requirement: Recovery password protector exists and is backed up to Active Directory.
VerificationCommands: manage-bde -protectors -get E:; Backup-BitLockerKeyProtector or AD recovery object check
ExpectedResult: Recovery Password protector exists for E: and corresponding recovery information is present in AD.
AwardGuidance: Award if recovery key can be retrieved by authorized administrator.

Category: G. BitLocker protected data volume
Requirement: E: is protected and accessible, with no broken encryption state.
ExpectedResult: ProtectionStatus is On; VolumeStatus is FullyEncrypted or EncryptionInProgress; proof file is readable.
AwardGuidance: For five-hour task, EncryptionInProgress is acceptable if ProtectionStatus is On.

Category: G. BitLocker protected data volume
Requirement: BitLocker proof file exists with required content.
ExpectedResult: File contains 'B5 BitLocker protected data volume'.
AwardGuidance: Exact wording may vary slightly only if meaning is clear.

Category: G. BitLocker protected data volume
Requirement: Ansible BitLocker validation playbook runs and report contains E: status.
VerificationCommands: From WSL: ansible-playbook playbooks/05-bitlocker-validation.yml; review reports/BJ-SRV01/b5-evidence.txt
ExpectedResult: Report contains Get-BitLockerVolume/manage-bde output for E:.
AwardGuidance: A generic success line is not enough.

Category: G. BitLocker protected data volume
Requirement: AD contains recovery information for BJ-SRV01 E: volume.
ExpectedResult: At least one BitLocker recovery information object exists for BJ-SRV01.
AwardGuidance: Award only if tied to BJ-SRV01.

Category: H. gMSA and scheduled task
Requirement: KDS root key exists for gMSA use.
ExpectedResult: KDS root key exists and permits gMSA password generation.
AwardGuidance: Lab shortcut -EffectiveTime in the past is acceptable.

Category: H. gMSA and scheduled task
Requirement: gMSA gmsa-b5-report$ exists in the required OU with correct allowed principals.
ExpectedResult: gMSA located under OU=40-B5-ServiceAccounts; PrincipalsAllowedToRetrieveManagedPassword includes GG_B5_GMSA_Hosts.
AwardGuidance: Do not award if normal user account is used instead of gMSA.

Category: H. gMSA and scheduled task
Requirement: gMSA target hosts are members of GG_B5_GMSA_Hosts.
ExpectedResult: SHA-FS01$ and BJ-SRV01$ are members.
AwardGuidance: This supports per-host gMSA installation.

Category: H. gMSA and scheduled task
Requirement: gMSA installs and tests successfully on SHA-FS01.
ExpectedResult: Test-ADServiceAccount returns True on SHA-FS01.
AwardGuidance: Checked on SHA-FS01 only.

Category: H. gMSA and scheduled task
Requirement: gMSA installs and tests successfully on BJ-SRV01.
ExpectedResult: Test-ADServiceAccount returns True on BJ-SRV01.
AwardGuidance: Checked on BJ-SRV01 only.

Category: H. gMSA and scheduled task
Requirement: Scheduled task B5-gMSA-Report runs as the gMSA and creates proof file.
VerificationCommands: Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName B5-gMSA-Report; Start-ScheduledTask B5-gMSA-Report; Get-Content C:\Skills\B5\gmsa-proof.txt
ExpectedResult: Task principal is NBB5\gmsa-b5-report$; proof file contains hostname and current date.
AwardGuidance: Do not award if task runs as Administrator.

Category: H. gMSA and scheduled task
Requirement: Ansible gMSA validation playbook runs and reports per-host results.
VerificationCommands: From WSL: ansible-playbook playbooks/06-gmsa-validation.yml; review reports/SHA-FS01 and reports/BJ-SRV01
ExpectedResult: Evidence contains Test-ADServiceAccount and scheduled task status where applicable.
AwardGuidance: Report must separate SHA-FS01 and BJ-SRV01.

Category: I. Security isolation and external management blocking
Requirement: WinRM from simulated Internet is blocked to domain controllers and member servers.
ExpectedResult: TcpTestSucceeded is False for all listed internal targets.
AwardGuidance: Use IP addresses, not hostnames.

Category: I. Security isolation and external management blocking
Requirement: Management ports from simulated Internet are blocked to DMZ hosts.
ExpectedResult: TcpTestSucceeded is False for all listed DMZ management/SMB checks.
AwardGuidance: Do not accept DNS failures as proof; targets must be tested by IP.

Category: I. Security isolation and external management blocking
Requirement: Internal management from SHA-CL01 works to all domain-managed hosts.
VerificationCommands: Test-WSMan SHA-DC01; Test-WSMan BJ-DC02; Test-WSMan SHA-FS01; Test-WSMan BJ-SRV01; Test-WSMan BJ-CL01
ExpectedResult: All Test-WSMan checks succeed from SHA-CL01.
AwardGuidance: This evaluates final management result; D rows evaluate per-host configuration.

Category: I. Security isolation and external management blocking
Requirement: Simulated Internet reachability exists without exposing internal management.
VerificationCommands: From internal host: ping/test route to 198.18.200.10; from INET-SRV01: route print
ExpectedResult: Transport path to INET-SRV01 works for allowed diagnostic reachability while management remains blocked by I-INET-CL01 checks.
AwardGuidance: Do not require real Internet access.

Category: I. Security isolation and external management blocking
Requirement: External isolation checks are documented in validation evidence.
VerificationCommands: Review C:\Skills\B5\B5-validation.txt and screenshots/log snippets if provided.
ExpectedResult: B5-validation.txt includes results for internal Test-WSMan and INET-CL01 blocking checks.
AwardGuidance: Evidence must cite IP-based tests.

Category: J. Ansible evidence collection and local submission
Requirement: Ansible baseline deploy creates managed-by-ansible.txt on each managed host.
VerificationCommands: From WSL: ansible-playbook playbooks/02-baseline-deploy.yml; ansible b5_windows -m win_command -a 'type C:\Skills\B5\managed-by-ansible.txt'
ExpectedResult: Each managed domain host has C:\Skills\B5\managed-by-ansible.txt containing 'This host is managed by Ansible for B5.'
AwardGuidance: Managed hosts are SHA-DC01, BJ-DC02, SHA-FS01, BJ-SRV01, BJ-CL01.

Category: J. Ansible evidence collection and local submission
Requirement: Collected b5-evidence.txt reports contain role-specific evidence, not empty placeholders.
ExpectedResult: DC reports contain AD/DNS/Sites/LAPS; member server reports contain local admins/WinRM/firewall/LAPS/gMSA; workstation report contains AppLocker/LAPS/WinRM; BJ-SRV01 report contains BitLocker.
AwardGuidance: Award only if contents are readable and host-specific.

Category: J. Ansible evidence collection and local submission
Requirement: Local submission folder contains required B5 scripts and Ansible project export.
ExpectedResult: All required files are present: B5-foundation.ps1, B5-transport-dmz.ps1, B5-ad-sites.ps1, B5-ad-objects.ps1, B5-gpo-baseline.ps1, B5-laps.ps1, B5-applocker.ps1, B5-bitlocker.ps1, B5-gmsa.ps1, ansible-b5-export.
AwardGuidance: Scripts must reflect actual configuration; they need not rebuild the whole lab unattended.

Category: J. Ansible evidence collection and local submission
Requirement: B5-validation.txt summarizes validation commands, results and known issues.
ExpectedResult: Includes commands, reachable Ansible hosts, transport/DMZ, LAPS, AppLocker, BitLocker, gMSA, external blocking and known issues.
AwardGuidance: Do not award if file is empty or generic.
